finding.claim: Proxy /nodes/* routes are reachable without a bearer token when --api-keys is set, because AuthenticationMiddleware skips the /nodes prefix. An unauthenticated client can register an attacker-controlled node, which then receives victims' Authorization headers and request bodies; the same routes also allow unauthenticated terminate_all and node removal.
finding.source: Unauthenticated HTTP client sending POST /nodes/add with a JSON body containing url and status.models (no Authorization header).
finding.sink: NodeManager.add force-registers the node (proxy.py:165-168); forward_raw_request_stream_generate forwards all client headers including Authorization to the registered node (proxy.py:386-390, _prepare_headers at proxy.py:450-458).

trace.note: requests whose path starts with a skip prefix bypass verify_token
AuthenticationMiddleware is installed on the proxy only when api_keys is set
non-empty status.models registers the node directly with no reachability check
_prepare_headers copies all incoming headers except host
forwarded request to node_url+endpoint carries those headers and the body
unauthenticated GET /nodes/terminate_all terminates all registered nodes via GET {node}/terminate (proxy.py:194)

finding.guards_checked: AuthenticationMiddleware skip_prefixes and path check (server_utils.py:90-95,125); validate_json_request is a Content-Type check only (server_utils.py:15-19), not authentication; no per-route auth dependency on /nodes/* routes; api_keys installation is conditional (proxy.py:924). Precondition: proxy started with api_keys (without keys nothing is authenticated).

finding.claim: The media URL fetcher validates the hostname's resolved IPs and then performs a separate DNS resolution when fetching, so a DNS-rebinding attacker can make the server request loopback or link-local/metadata addresses.
finding.source: image_url / video_url / audio_url string in POST /v1/chat/completions content, with an attacker-controlled DNS name.
finding.sink: requests.Session().get(parsed.url) at connection.py:83 after _is_safe_url at connection.py:79 resolved the name separately.

trace.note: _is_safe_url resolves DNS via getaddrinfo and checks is_global
requests re-resolves the hostname; no IP pinning
redirects are re-validated per hop, so the gap is the initial rebinding

finding.guards_checked: Scheme allowlist; is_global IP check on getaddrinfo results; optional allowed_media_domains (default None, so unrestricted in api_server); redirects disabled and re-validated per hop. No IP pinning between check and fetch.

finding.claim: Media URL loading accepts file:// URLs and raw filesystem paths with no restriction, letting an unauthenticated client read any server file that decodes as image, video, audio, npy, or csv; model output can exfiltrate image contents.
finding.source: image_url / video_url / audio_url string in POST /v1/chat/completions, e.g. file:///path or an absolute or relative path.
finding.sink: _load_file_url (connection.py:112-116) builds a Path; ImageMediaIO.load_file opens it (image.py:31-35); similar load_file paths exist for video, audio, and time series.

trace.note: image_url string is passed to load_from_url with no scheme or path check
accepts scheme == 'file' or os.path.exists(url) or os.path.exists(url_spec.path)

finding.guards_checked: Searched lmdeploy/serve for file:// or path restrictions before load_from_url; none found. Media decode step limits output to media-shaped files. Error-text content not verified.
